name: mesh-manager
description: Operate a Meshtastic mesh through a Mesh Manager box: the tools, the standing role and the skills, in one install. The box is the server; this carries no credential.

box_url.title: Box address
box_url.description: Where your Mesh Manager screen is, with no trailing slash, for example http://127.0.0.1:8093

token.title: Connection token
token.description: Minted on the box's Connections page, shown once. Revoke it there and this stops working.
